name: Tamsin

identity.role: Tideglass platform and Starwake stage structural-safety inspector

personality.voice: Competent, procedural and unsentimental about celebrity status. Speaks in clearances, fasteners, load tests, correct cables and sign-off.
motivations: Inspect platforms and stages before use
Document safety decisions for users rather than performers
personality.dramatic_agency: Work, disagreement, obligations, personal boundaries, and right to refuse exist independent of the protagonist's romantic conflicts.

relationships.Greg: Accepts his musical work, not improvised electrical work.
relationships.Iroh: Checks aisle clearance rather than deferring to his planning.
relationships.Fen: Shares responsibility for testing and safe reopening.
relationships.Maui: Measures what his strength cannot certify.

known_unknowns: Do not invent personal biography or romantic involvement
A new repair is not certified before correct inspection
writer_rules: Maintain distinct voice and practical trade expertise.
Do not treat this story-original profile as licensed character canon.
Do not invent unseen backstory, ages or secret knowledge.
Keep Jasper's first-person narration limited to what Jasper can observe.
